scope: Theorem 12.6 (A periodic force with no loading interval) of the manuscript “Incompressible Box Transport and Finite Computation” (preprints/Incompressible-Box-Transport-and-Finite-Computation-October-6-2026/manuscript.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 376 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 2505dc09d3f2c24b), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 57. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: Fix a positive computable ν. A deterministic one-tape machine and finite input word in cells 0, . . . , L − 1, with other cells blank and initial head zero, effectively determine a general body force on R3 extending smoothly and one-periodically to all real times. It has uniformly compact spatial support and bounded mixed derivatives. Its zero-data solution has a unique global smooth velocity in (38), with constructed pressure zero, and ∃t ≥ 0 : (Φt((−2, 0, 0)))1 > 0 ⇐⇒ the machine halts. The fixed label is already the initial code; periodicity begins at zero.
